notion_page_update: Implemented v0.9 Phase 5 Daily Field Debrief Studio on branch feature/v0.9-field-sensemaking. Added dedicated end-of-day sensemaking workspace situated between Evidence and Findings. Features: 7 guided practitioner reflection questions (surprises, patterns, contradictions, shaken assumptions, researcher biases, missing perspectives with Phase 2 gap detector signal integration, emerging hypotheses), multi-site support (study-wide or multi-location sessions), discrete tomorrow priorities manager, and explicit linking of today's field sources and evidence observations. Enforced strict architectural boundaries: no ValidationStatus on debriefs, non-mutation invariant for evidence records, contradiction independence, emerging hypothesis isolation behind explicit Boundary Guardrail warning banners, and suppression of linear claim lineage in the Traceability Drawer for DBR-* records while preserving linked record inspection. Pristine demo templates protected with cloning. Added 12 new Vitest unit/storage tests (103 total tests passing across 11 files), comprehensive technical guide in docs/v0.9_daily_debrief_guide.md, and 11-step automated CDP browser acceptance audit with 10 screenshots. ESLint and Next.js production build pass cleanly.
